releases.body: Clearer public-link wording, improved first-share consent, and installation/upgrade documentation.
First npm release published through Trusted Publishing (OIDC) with provenance.
Plugin edge-case fix: a remote share without its local sync secret is now re-created with a fresh secret instead of returning a share that cannot update.

Initial public release.

- Self-hosted service with Docker image `ghcr.io/duo-huang/opencode-session-share:v0.1.0`
- OpenCode TUI plugin: `/share` and `/unshare`
- Complete body text, lazy tool/thinking details, message pagination, global index, and user/assistant search
- Self-host instructions in the README
